notes.title: We're so back update 03/08/25
notes.content:
Sorry guys for no update for god knows how long my real life situation has been abit of a emotional rollercoaster, I'll be honest I don't even remember what's actually been done in this update since I've been just silently spending like a few minutes on conviction for the past few months but I know three things I've done at least (I am the greatest game developer ever)

-Fixed brightness slider
-Buffed Gatling damage
-Fixed enemy AI pathfinding and remapped all AI navigation in levels (for the last time I hope)

notes.title: 26.10.24 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Okay its been abit since the games been updated what was suppose to be a one month break turned into quite along time back were back and full of energy to finish the job to celebrate this ([i]I totally wasn't playing the game and realised how bad it was before updating it[/i]) were releasing a semi big update to just give the game abit more polish and for things to come so lets go through what's been added/ changed

NEW:
-New enemy models (not all enemies are done quite yet but the main guys are done rest will be updated soon!)
-New enemy animations
-New pickup UI
-Improved textures
-Added a Dodge and Crouch mechanic (Shift to dodge and Control to crouch)
-Minor level design improvements 

Gonna try and pump out another update before the month ends to just tweak and add some more polish thank you for your patience!

notes.title: General Content Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys really sorry for lack of communication on my end unfortunately I was not able to get all of chapter 2 done last month due to my real life job taking up my time and other responsibilities in the mean time I've decided to update the game with what I've done so far and hoping this month chapter 2 will be nice and the game will just feel more polished in general anyway lets talk about what's been done!

NEW ADDITIONS:

- 2 NEW LEVEL

- NEW WEAPON (The Gatling)

- VISUAL OVERHAUL (Still more to come!)

- GENERAL FIXES


That's right we've added two brand new levels for you to try out with access to the newest weapon in your arsenal the Gatling gun!

On top of that I've started a visual overhaul for the game and the new textures really make the game pop out more!

notes.title: Weapon Pickups update
notes.content: another quick short and sweet update levels 2 and 4 now have pickups for the revolver and shotgun makes alot more sense then just being in your inventory from the get go. (I'm pretty sure most people don't even know they had guns at this point so hopefully this clears some confusion)

notes.title: Chapter 2 Announcement + General Visuals Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone just wanted to leave a quick announcement post that Chapter 2 of Conviction is almost done and should be released around the end of April!

The chapter will include:
- 5 New playable levels
- 2 New enemy variants
- 2 New weapons

Aside from this I'm currently working on updating the visuals of the game with some nice fancy textures here and there since the game is looking abit flat I've also taken the time to learn to animate in blender so I plan on working on making new enemy attack animations etc.

Thank you for your time I look forward to everyone enjoying Chapter 2 of Conviction!

notes.title: Prep update for major update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, got a very exciting update today as this update is mostly laying the foundation for a more refined conviction experience for the first major update hopefully at the end of the month!

But lets take a look at what been added / changed:

- Swapped out save game system for a level select instead

- Improved AI pathing and collisions for both enemies and the player

- Revamped level 3 abit mostly cause I wasn't happy with some parts of it

- In-game FPS toggle in settings (will only be available from levels 1-3 since 4-5 will be getting changed out soon)

- Keybind weapon switching using numpad buttons (Will implement key bind switching soon, but for now this should be better then just scrolling a wheel to switch)

Thank you guys for reading, hopefully the next update will be out by the end of the month.
